simulation_01.finding: prefer compact pointers + just-in-time retrieval + provenance + isolated MCP/skills exposure; B04 provides HF bridge/eval primitives

simulation_02.finding: research must be a gated decision after literal-input preservation and deterministic intent/entity normalization; tool/skill schemas should be progressively disclosed only when selected

facts: OpenAI web/file tools dynamically retrieve current/private information and web search returns citations
Anthropic recommends the smallest high-signal context and just-in-time retrieval
Hugging Face MCP returns Hub results with metadata links and context; hf_fs is a primary Hub navigation tool
GitHub repository MCP tools can act autonomously once configured and capability support differs by transport/auth surface
OpenClaw treats third-party skills as untrusted code and recommends sandboxing; skill visibility is not equivalent to authorization
Hermes community has a current report where repeated successful tool_search calls saturated context, so successful discovery/search is not sufficient operational evidence
inferences: every retrieved item in CONTEXT_PACKAGE should carry source_url/source_id, retrieved_at/freshness, evidence_class, contradiction_state and capability_state
tool capability states should distinguish DISCOVERED, CONFIGURED, HEALTHCHECKED and OPERATIONALLY_VERIFIED
coverage should stop on evidence sufficiency plus contradiction resolution rather than unlimited successful search
compression must preserve citations/provenance and unresolved contradictions rather than flattening them
unknowns: compression ratio that preserves downstream answer quality

simulation_04.scenario: ambiguous entity plus conflicting fresh sources plus tool-discovery pressure
facts: OpenAI provides dynamic web/file retrieval for current/private information
Anthropic recommends smallest high-signal context and just-in-time exploration
GitHub supports explicit tool selection and on-demand tool search instead of loading every tool
OpenClaw states skill allowlists are visibility filters rather than shell authorization boundaries
Hermes community evidence shows successful repeated tool_search can still exhaust context
MCP-Atlas provides 500 tool-use benchmark tasks across real MCP servers and reports coverage diagnostics
inferences: entity ambiguity must survive normalization until evidence resolves it
research outcome should explicitly distinguish ANSWERABLE, ANSWERABLE_WITH_CAVEATS and ABSTAIN_NEEDS_REVIEW
stop_reason should be explicit and machine-readable
unresolved contradiction must survive compression into CONTEXT_PACKAGE
benchmark evaluation can test whether stop/abstention policy reduces tool loops without hiding evidence gaps
